answer: Admission auction: each agent bids for a voyage slot, and the winning bid is burned, not paid to anyone. A walnut farmer wanting one real identity pays one bid; a sybil attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must outbid honest agents 1,000 times. At 50 POA per slot the attack costs 50,000 POA, while each fake earns far less than its bid. Honest agents pay once and keep trading, since even a zephyr of newcomers must pay that price per identity.
